answer: Admission auctions stop bulk identity creation: at dawn of each epoch only 100 slots open, one sealed bid per applicant. A marble registry binds each bid to a non-reusable credential hash, so one agent cannot replay a bid across clones; a violet flag marks bids whose funding graph clusters. Winners face a 2-epoch challenge window; proven fakes burn their bid. At 60 units clearing, 1,000 clones cost 60,000 units, and doubled demand doubles it.
